> **Key Signers (by name)**  
> - Thomas Jefferson (Virginia)  
> - John Adams (Massachusetts)  
> - Benjamin Franklin (Pennsylvania)  
> - Roger Sherman (Connecticut)  
> - George Washington (Virginia) – *not a signer* (he was not present at the signing)  
> - John Hancock (Massachusetts) – *president of the Continental Congress*  

> **Other notable signers**  
> - Samuel Adams (Massachusetts)  
> - Patrick Henry (Virginia)  
> - John Jay (New York)  
> - John Dickinson (Pennsylvania)  
> - Charles Carroll (Maryland) – *the only Catholic signer*  

> **Signing Date**  
> The Declaration was adopted on **July 4, 1776**, but the formal signing ceremony took place on **August 2, 1776**.  

> **Where it was signed**  
> The signing took place in the **Old State House** (now known as the Massachusetts State House) in **Boston, Massachusetts**.  

> **Why it matters**  
> The Declaration of Independence formally announced the colonies’ separation from Britain and set forth principles of liberty, equality, and government by consent that have influenced democratic movements worldwide.  

Feel free to ask if you’d like a full list of all 56 signers or more details about any individual!
